reviewer.method: Read the new D1-D14.project-envelope-a clauses and previously read rules.md. No product code, fixture, test, todo or implementation output inspected. Independently reconstructed public calls and PEA1-PEA12 expectations.

verdictScope: Design determinism of the three project-envelope-a pure functions under their documented preconditions only. Does not approve implementation, certify execution, pass the complete foundation-r7 design, or verify an unread fixture.

types.text: JavaScript string parsed with JSON.parse and finite-number validation.
types.validateWorkspace: Synchronous function taking an independent JSON deep clone of the parsed workspace. Only strict true accepts. Throw, false, all other values and Promise returns synchronously fail with WORKSPACE_INVALID.
types.ProjectId: String p followed by a positive decimal integer with no leading zero and numeric part <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
types.envelope: E(W), specified completely in definitions below; a fresh root and fresh parsed workspace graph per successful call.
types.root: Previously validated canonical v7 envelope. select additionally checks the specified root/projects object shape, version and target checks in order; it does not perform general v7 validation.
types.error: Error instance with name ProjectStateError and code/message equal to the exact prescribed error code. No extra domain payload.

definitions.W2: Independent deep clone of W, equal by JSON value.
definitions.R2: E(W) with projectSeq=3, projectOrder=[p1,p2], and own projects.p2={name:두 번째,enabled:true,props:{connectionRef:default,dataEnabled:true,automationEnabled:false},workspace:W2}; activeProjectId remains p1.
definitions.mutate: Set callback argument marker to changed and return true.
definitions.comparison: Object key order ignored, array order preserved, values and types exact; -0 compares as JSON number 0. Identity assertions are additional and explicit.

mismatches.message: The phrase all inputs produce zero external requests/file writes must be understood as operations owned by these functions. An injected validator can itself perform arbitrary external actions; the function cannot prevent that merely by supplying a clone.
mismatches.recommendation: Clarify that lifecycle/I/O zero guarantees cover module-owned behavior and that side effects of caller-supplied validation are outside this module contract. PEA callbacks are side-effect-free apart from mutation of the isolated clone, so the selected expectations remain deterministic.

boundaryAssessment.fourAxes: STATE-only placement agrees with B4. No new Engine, Add-on or Bridge behavior is introduced; direct imports and ambient I/O are forbidden.
boundaryAssessment.persistence: Only an in-memory envelope value is produced. File migration/backups, generic CRUD integration, v5 conversion and validation implementation remain outside this slice.
boundaryAssessment.multiProject: Selection changes one root field and preserves project/workspace identity. It does not implement operational subscription switching or multi-symbol synchronization.
boundaryAssessment.preconditionLimit: select accepts a previously canonical root; adversarial getters/proxies, invalid project entry structures and whole-envelope repair are not a hidden validation requirement.
boundaryAssessment.performance: Wrap visits input and clones once, with external validator cost excluded. Selection touches fixed root fields and one target; it need not scan projects/items.
